title: Wine Tour FAQs: Casablanca Valley, Valparaíso & Santiago

items.a: Our standard tours run in the Casablanca Valley, plus city tours in Valparaíso and Viña del Mar. We also arrange custom tours in Maipo, Aconcagua and Colchagua.

items.q: What is included in a wine tour?
items.a: Transport, guided visits to wineries, tastings, and cultural insights. Lunch on arrangement.
Some tours include lunch at a winery or local restaurant; details vary by package.

items.q: How do I book a tour?
items.a: Through our website, email, or by contacting us directly.
items.aHtml: Through our website, email, or by contacting us directly.

items.q: Do I need to book in advance? How far ahead?
items.a: At least 24 hours.
We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and cash in Chilean pesos.
Full refunds are available with 48 hours' notice; partial refunds after that.

items.q: Do you pick up from Santiago?
items.a: Yes, tours can start from Santiago, Valparaíso, or Viña del Mar.

items.q: Do you offer shore excursions from the Valparaíso and San Antonio cruise ports?
items.a: Yes — we collect and drop off at both the Valparaíso cruise terminal and the port of San Antonio. Pricing for Valparaíso pickup is shown in our price calculator; for San Antonio, contact us and we'll quote you directly. Every tour page lists its full duration, so you can match a half-day or full-day tour to the time your ship is in port.
Comfortable private transport is included in all tours.

items.q: What languages are tours offered in?
items.a: Tours are conducted in English and Spanish.
Children are welcome, though tastings are reserved for adults.
